# simple-sftp-uploader
> A bundler-agnostic plugin for uploading a project dist directory to a remote server over SFTP.
Canonical project page: https://projects.imba97.dev/projects/simple-sftp-uploader/
GitHub: https://github.com/imba97/simple-sftp-uploader
Status: documented
Last verified: 2026-11-17
